visibility: Release audit; disclose with coordinated security release 0.18.0
private_pr: Historical remediation PR in the temporary advisory fork, PR #1
auditor: Codex; automated review, no human approval claimed
conclusion: The unauthorized-issuer vulnerability and two certificate-set boundary findings are fixed in the 0.18.0 release candidate. The candidate includes the main branch signer-selection fix. Actual registry availability is tracked on the security advisory.

findings.description: Malformed trailing certificates were dropped while a parsed prefix could still produce Trusted.
findings.fix: Reject malformed or unsupported CertificateChoices instead of accepting a partial certificate set.

findings.description: The 32-certificate limit silently truncated a larger set instead of refusing to assess the incomplete set.
findings.fix: Return Unsupported when the complete certificate set exceeds the limit; retain acceptance at the exact boundary.

findings.description: The draft lists only 0.17.0, although the same verifier source is present in released versions starting with 0.11.0.

additional_coverage: Intermediate path-length zero rejects another intermediate authority below it.
Intermediate path-length one permits one lower authority and does not count the end entity.
Unknown critical extensions, malformed/duplicate BasicConstraints and invalid key usages remain rejected.
Explicitly pinned end-entity signers retain their documented trust behavior.

release_integration.requirement: Include the public SignerInfo.sid selection fix from PR #122 in the same release so trust verification starts from the actual CMS signer.
release_integration.test: Combined issuer-constraint, certificate-set boundary and signer-selection regressions
release_integration.result: Resolved merge matches the verified combined implementation; complete 0.18.0 workspace validation passed

validation.released_v017_negative_regression: Failed as expected: the released verifier accepts the non-CA issuer chain
